subject: BridgeFrame MAP: evaluation milestones and sequencing to signature
messages:
From: Maria Torres <maria.torres@bridgeframe.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP + Eval plan -> sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form

Hi Hannah / team,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looked promising and procurement here is ready to map out a concrete path to signature. We put a very small internal evaluation plan together and would like Redwood to confirm sequencing across the legal artifacts so we can align our internal stakeholders (security, legal, procurement, and engineering).

High level ask: can you provide a mutual action plan (MAP) that ties evaluation milestones to the legal milestones (MSA redline, DPA review, order form) and indicates owners and target dates? Our informal target is to be signed by mid-October, but that depends on two items: SOC2 evidence and finalization of DPA terms around data residency.

Attached is our quick intake ("BridgeFrame_MAP_v1.xlsx") — minimal fields: milestone, owner, dependency, and blocker notes.

Questions from our side:
- Are you able to accept a limited DPA deviation for EU data residency (we host in their EU cloud region)?
- What is your standard turnaround for MSA redline review (legal to legal)?

Appreciate a one-page MAP and a simple timeline so I can present to our procurement lead tomorrow.

Thanks,
Maria Torres
Head of Procurement | BridgeFrame

---
Attachment: BridgeFrame_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maria Torres <maria.torres@bridgeframe.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + Eval plan -> sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form

Maria — thanks for the intake and the clear ask. Looping in Laura (legal ops) and Jordan (sales ops) to own parts of the MAP. Quick response below and an attached prioritized MAP we can operate against; I also pushed a live copy to the Drive link.

Summary of our recommended sequencing (fast path):
1) Eval milestone: Proof-of-concept completion (engineering sign-off) — target: 2027-09-24 — owner: BridgeFrame eng. dependency: device sample access
2) Evidence: SOC2 artifact & security questionnaire — target: 2027-09-29 — owner: BridgeFrame security / Redwood will provide evidence package
3) MSA: Redwood to provide standard MSA + we accept customer's redlines review — initial legal exchange complete by 2027-10-03 — owner: Laura Bennett (Redwood Legal)
4) DPA: run in parallel with MSA review; we can provision a limited EU-residency addendum for your region — DPA agreed by 2027-10-08 — owner: Laura Bennett + BridgeFrame legal
5) Order form: finance/pricing sign-off and signature — target: 2027-10-12 — owner: Jordan Blake (Redwood Sales)

Notes and constraints:
- If SOC2 evidence is delayed more than three business days after the PoC signoff, we recommend a short acceptance window extension (adds 1 week).
- For DPA deviations around EU residency: our standard approach is a region-specific addendum (not a full DPA rewrite). Laura, I'll send our DPA summary table and the clause we typically use.
- We will keep a rolling redline tracker (attached: MSA_redlines_hs_20270905.pdf).

Next steps I propose:
- Laura to share the redline-tracker and DPA summary by EOD 2027-09-07.
- Joint 30-minute touchpoint Wednesday 2027-09-08 to resolve any quick legal questions.
- Jordan to open a HubSpot deal and add the MAP milestones (thanks for the intake, Maria).

CC: Laura / Jordan — please confirm ownership and any timing concerns.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: MSA_redlines_hs_20270905.pdf (redline tracker), DPA_summary_table.xlsx (summary)

From: Kyle Long <kyle.long@bridgeframe.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Torres <maria.torres@bridgeframe.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + Eval plan -> sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form

Hannah / Laura — quick clarifying questions from our security/legal stack after reviewing the MAP: 

1) Data residency: BridgeFrame needs confirmation that EU customer data can be pinned to our EU tenant for logging and backups. A regional addendum sounds fine; can you confirm the technical control and include it in the DPA addendum?
2) Insurance: our legal team requires your general liability and cyber insurance limits for procurement. We typically expect evidence in the DPA package (certificate).
3) Turnaround: our legal expects a 3-business-day response on MSA redlines (first pass). Is that feasible?

If you can confirm these three items in writing we can commit the internal resources to meet the timeline. We also prefer DocuSign for signatures; will that be OK?

Thanks,
Kyle Long
Sr. Security Program Manager | BridgeFrame

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Long <kyle.long@bridgeframe.ai>, Maria Torres <maria.torres@bridgeframe.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Kickoff: MAP + Eval plan -> sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form

Kyle — appreciate the checklist. Quick confirmations below and the updated action items.

- EU data residency: Redwood can pin logs/backups for the BridgeFrame account to our EU region. Laura has added the standard residency clause to the DPA_summary_table.xlsx and included the control IDs.
- Insurance: attached in the Drive link is our current certificate of insurance (COI) and cyber coverage summary; Laura will include a formal certificate as part of the DPA package.
- Turnaround: we will commit to a first-pass response to MSA redlines within 3 business days for requests limited to standard commercial terms. For aggressive legal rewrites we will flag and route for leadership.

Operational next steps (updated MAP milestones):
- Laura to send DPA draft and COI by EOD 2027-09-07.
- Joint touchpoint to resolve any immediate redlines: 2027-09-08 at 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent).
- Jordan will create the HubSpot milestone set and assign owners (hubspot:deals/BRIDGE-1123).

Maria / Kyle — if you confirm SOC2 artifact delivery by 2027-09-29 we will lock the order form signature target of 2027-10-12. Otherwise we'll add a one-week buffer.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this across the finish line.

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

Attachments referenced: DPA_summary_table.xlsx, link to COI in Drive
